scope: Coordinator product (watchability) check, NOT a held-out performance evaluation. Mirror bouts: the same model in both corners, product format 3x45 s rounds + 8 s breaks, seeded sampling temperature 0.8, learned strategist (no external style). Separate seed bank 9000-9059 (not the 5000/6000 held-out banks, not validation 2000+). Local CPU Node simulation.

engine.note: live engine includes referee-only edits after the training marker b5e3a11c; fighters/events verified identical by the contact and neuro-2 engineers

decision: Product model switched from s3 (validation-rule pick) to s1: s2 and s3 almost never attack in mirror bouts (no attack in round 1 in 93% / 72% of bouts; 0.2 / 2.1 hits per bout), which made the default fly-brain-vs-fly-brain bout a motionless points draw. s1 attacks from the first tick (85 round-1 attacks, 47.6 hits per bout, 3% draws) and switches style about 10 times per corner per bout. Held-out results of every seed stay as reported in evidence-style.json; s1 is weaker than s2/s3 against the held-out snapshots (0.543/0.578).
limits: No KO in any neuro-2 mirror bout (neuro-1 mirror: 30% KO).
Spectator criteria were chosen after seeing the held-out results; this is a product choice, not a performance claim.
